description: Get MQA (Metadata Quality Assessment) quality score for a dataset on dati.gov.it from data.europa.eu. Returns the final score on the 0-7.5 scale of MQA methodology v2 with its band (Sufficient/Good/Excellent), dataset, distribution and data service scores, and the failing metrics with the largest gain. Datasets not yet re-evaluated fall back to the previous methodology (405 scale), labelled as such. Only works with dati.gov.it server. Typical workflow: ckan_package_show (get dataset ID) → ckan_get_mqa_quality → ckan_get_mqa_quality_details (full list of failing metrics)

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for machine-readable

name: ckan_get_mqa_quality
title: Get MQA Quality Score
